titleInfo.title: value investors
titleInfo.subTitle: lessons from the world's top fund managers

abstract.#text: Author Ronald Chan interviewed twelve value-investing legends from around the world, learning how their personal background, culture, and life experiences have shaped their investment mindset and strategy.

mods.tableOfContents: Chapter 1. Free to choose in value land : Walter Schloss, Walter & Edwin Schloss Associates -- Chapter 2. Once upon a time on wall street : Irving Kahn, Kahn Brothers Group -- Chapter 3: The making of a contrarian : Thomas Kahn, Kahn Brothers Group -- Chapter 4: On the shoulders of value giants : William Browne, Tweedy, Browne Company -- Chapter 5: A journey to the center of value : Jean-Marie Eveillard, First Eagle Funds -- Chapter 6: The self-taught value Spaniard : Francisco García Paramés, Bestinver Asset Management -- Chapter 7. The income-conscious Englishman : Anthony Nutt, Jupiter Asset Management -- Chapter 8: The frequent value traveler : Mark Mobius, Templeton Emerging Markets Group -- Chapter 9. The value-oriented businessman : Teng Ngiek Lian, Target Asset Management -- Chapter 10. Value investing in the lost decade : Shuhei Abe, SPARX Group -- Chapter 11. Eternal sunshine of the value mind : V-Nee Yeh, Value Partners Group -- Chapter 12: The accidental value investor : Cheah Cheng Hye, Value Partners group -- Chapter 13. The making of a value investor.
